caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF George M. NACHWALTER.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF George M. NACHWALTER.

George M. Nachwalter, of Miami, Florida, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
